name: JVM target
meaning: The JVM bytecode compatibility level selected when compiling Kotlin.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: numeric inference
meaning: Inferring a fixed numeric type from an expression rather than declaring it explicitly.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: explicit numeric conversion
meaning: Calling a conversion such as toInt to obtain another numeric representation.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: string template
meaning: Text containing placeholders whose values are inserted when the string is evaluated.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: nullable input
meaning: An input result that explicitly allows absence, represented by null.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: safe call
meaning: The ?. operation that calls a member only on a non-null receiver.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Elvis operator
meaning: The ?: operator that supplies an alternative only when the left value is null.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: smart cast
meaning: Compiler-supported use of a more specific type after a valid stable type check.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: when expression
meaning: A Kotlin expression selecting a result from matching branches.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: half-open range
meaning: A range including its start but excluding its end.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: loop control
meaning: Changing a loop’s progress with continue for one pass or break for the whole loop.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: array mutation
meaning: Changing an existing element of a fixed-size array.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: read-only collection
meaning: A collection interface that exposes reading but does not guarantee deep immutability.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: map lookup
meaning: Retrieving a value by key while accounting for a missing entry.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: set membership
meaning: Whether a distinct value is present in a set.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: default argument
meaning: A parameter value used when a call omits that argument.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: spread operator
meaning: The call-site * that supplies array elements as vararg arguments.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: higher-order function
meaning: A function that receives another function or returns one.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: closure
meaning: A function value that can use values from its surrounding scope.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: scope function
meaning: A function such as let or also that provides a context value to a lambda with a defined return convention.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.
